historical_definition: Ensemble of5old10kouter models; any-member gain clipping reported; old training uncertainty conditioned on.

uncertainty.full_method: Independent within70k/15k/15k role resampling, repeated preprocessing/knots/tuning/85krefit/15kclosure and common20kvalidation resampling; includes model selection.
